duas.title: After a Nightmare
duas.arabic: أَعُوْذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللّٰهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ غَضَبِهِ وَعِقَابِهِ ، وَشَرِّ عِبَادِهِ ، وَمِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِيْنِ وَأَنْ يَّحْضُرُوْنِ.
duas.transliteration: Aʿūdhu bi kalimāt-i-llāhi-t-tāmmāti min ghaḍabihi wa ʿiqābih, wa sharri ʿibādih, wa min hamazāti-sh-shayaṭīn wa an yaḥḍurūn.
duas.translation: I seek protection in the perfect words of Allah from His anger and punishment, and from the evil of His servants, and from the evil suggestions of the devils and from them appearing to me.
duas.virtue:
## Hadith About Using This Dua

ʿAmr b. Shuʿayb narrated from his father, who narrated from his grandfather, that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

**What to Do When Frightened During Sleep:**
- "When one of you becomes frightened during sleep, then let him say the above"
- **Promise:** "For verily, they shall not harm him"

**ʿAbdullah b. ʿAmr's Practice:**
- He used to teach it to those of his children who attained maturity
- For those who did not reach maturity, he would write it on a sheet and hang it around their neck

**(Tirmidhī 3528)**

## Hadith About Good and Bad Dreams

The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

**Good Dreams:**
- "A good dream is from Allah"
- "If anyone of you sees a dream which pleases him, he should not tell anybody about it except to the one whom he loves"

**Bad Dreams:**
- "If he sees a dream which he dislikes, then he should seek Allah's protection from its evil and from the evil of Shayṭān"
- "He should spit three times on his left"
- "He should not tell anybody about it, lest it might harm him"

**(Bukhārī 6986)**
